The company serves individuals, contractors, builders, institutions, and government agencies. Barak Valley Cements Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Delhi, India.

CIEINDIA.NS.d: CIE Automotive India Limited, founded in 1999 and based in Mumbai, makes and supplies auto components to OEMs and other customers in India and Europe. Products include forged parts like crankshafts and steering components, stamped body and chassis systems, gears, shafts and axle, transmission and engine parts, as well as magnetic products, molding compounds and aluminum castings.

DEEPINDS.NS.d: Deep Industries Limited engages in the oil and gas services business. The company is based in Ahmedabad, India.

DIXON.NS.d: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited operates in the electronic manufacturing services space in India. The company offers consumer electronics, including LED TVs; home appliances, such as washing machines; lighting products comprising LED bulbs, battens, indoor and outdoor LED drivers, electronics lamp drivers, and down lighters; mobile phones; and security surveillance systems.

DOLPHIN.NS.d: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited serves India's oil and gas sector with offshore and marine services. It was set up in Mumbai in 1979 and offers diving of several kinds, design and engineering, ship and rig repair, marine logistics, vessel management, fabrication, offshore hook-up and commissioning, and turnkey EPC contracts.

EASTWEST.NS.d: East West Freight Carriers Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker EASTWEST and traded in INR. Its country is India.

EFACTOR.NS.d: E Factor Experiences Ltd. is an experiential engagement company operating across the events, tourism, and multimedia sectors. The company provides a comprehensive range of services, including the conceptualization, design, and execution of large-scale social events, cultural festivals, sports events, luxury weddings, and corporate conferences. In the tourism sector, it specializes in experiential tourism, managing eco-tourism projects such as hot air ballooning and specialized glamping sites.

FACT.NS.d: The Fertilisers And Chemicals Travancore Limited manufactures and markets fertilizers in India. It operates through Fertiliser and Petrochemical segments. The company offers complex fertilizers, including ammonium phosphate sulphate and zincated factamfos; straight fertilizers, such as ammonium sulphate; organic fertilizers; bio-fertilizers comprising azospirillum, rhizobium, and phosphate solubilizing bacteria; and bagged gypsum.

GARFIBRES.NS.d: Garware Technical Fibres Limited manufactures and sells various technical textile products worldwide. It offers fishing nets, ropes, and twines for the deep sea fishing industry; aquaculture cages and predator systems; synthetic ropes for various applications from power transmission to marine hawsers for shipping, mooring, and towing applications; and yarn and thread solutions under the Garlon brand.

GARUDA.NS.d: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited provides civil construction and engineering services in India. Its portfolio spans industrial, infrastructure, hospitality, mixed-use, commercial and residential projects, and it also builds concrete and composite steel building frames.

GESHIP.NS.d: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the shipping and offshore oilfield businesses in India and internationally. The company is involved in the transportation of crude oil, petroleum products, and gas and dry bulk commodities through dry bulk carriers and tankers.

HAPPSTMNDS.NS.d: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited offers IT solutions and services in India, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the Netherlands, and the Middle East. The company operates through three segments: Infrastructure Management & Security Services (IMSS); Digital Business Solutions (DBS); and Product Engineering Services (PES).

HCL-INSYS.NS.d: HCL Infosystems Limited sells computer hardware and mobile handsets to enterprises and consumers primarily in India. It operates through Hardware Products & Solution, Learning, and distribution segments. The Hardware Products and Solutions segment sells IT products and solutions to enterprise and government customers.

HMAAGRO.NS.d: HMA Agro Industries Limited makes and exports frozen buffalo meat and related products to markets such as Vietnam, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Malaysia and Egypt. It also supplies chilled meat, fish, rice, produce, animal nutrition goods and pet food, under labels including Black Gold, Green Gold, Fresh Gold and Kamil. Incorporated in 2008, it is based in Agra.

IFBAGRO.NS.d: IFB Agro Industries Limited manufactures and distributes alcoholic beverages, and processed marine foods in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Spirit, Liquor and Spirituous Beverages; and Marine Products. The company offers extra neutral alcohol and Indian made Indian liquor products; value-added ingredients for poultry, aqua, cattle, and swine feed; food grade carbon dioxide; dry ice; and feed nutrition boosters.

INDIAGLYCO.NS.d: India Glycols Limited, a green petrochemical company, manufactures and sells industrial chemicals in India. The company operates through Industrial Chemical, Ethyl Alcohol, and Nutraceuticals segments. It offers monoethylene, diethylene, and triethylene glycols; polyethylene glycols; fatty alcohol, acid, and amine ethoxylates; alkyl phenol ethoxylates; castor/natural oil ethoxylates; and ethoxylated and propoxylated co-polymers.

INGERRAND.NS.d: Ingersoll-Rand (India) Limited manufactures and sells industrial air compressors primarily in India. The company offers reciprocating air-cooled and water-cooled, contact cooled and oil free rotary screw, and centrifugal compressors; and cycling and non-cycling refrigerated dryers. It sells its products under the Club Car, Ingersoll Rand, Nash, Thomas, CompAir, and ARO brand names, as well as other brands.

JAYBARMARU.NS.d: Jay Bharat Maruti Limited manufactures and sells auto components and assemblies in India. It offers sheet metal components, welded assemblies, exhaust systems, fuel fillers, rear axles, muffler assemblies, fuel necks, tools and dies, spare parts, components, BIW parts, and suspension parts for motor vehicles. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Gurugram, India.

JINDRILL.NS.d: Jindal Drilling & Industries Limited provides drilling services to the oil and gas sector in India. It provides offshore drilling, horizontal and directional drilling, and mud logging services, as well as measurement while drilling services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

KRSNAA.NS.d: Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited provides diagnostic services using technology, among them tele-radiology, clinical pathology and radiology. Its clients across India include community health centres, medical colleges, and healthcare facilities in both the public and private sectors.

KSE.NS.d: KSE Limited is a diversified business whose chief activity is the manufacture of compound animal feed. It also extracts oil from copra cake and refines it to edible grade, and produces dairy products such as ice cream. Its business is organised in segments including Animal Feed and Oil Cake Processing.

LAXMIINDIA.NS.d: Laxmi India Finance Limited, established in 1996 and headquartered in Jaipur, is a non-banking financial company serving individuals, businesses and organizations across India. It lends to MSMEs, wholesale borrowers, and for personal needs and residential development, and finances vehicles including two-wheelers, tractors, commercial vehicles and electric vehicles.

MAHLOG.NS.d: Mahindra Logistics Limited provides third party logistic services in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Enterprise Mobility Services (EMS). The SCM segment offers customized and end-to-end logistics solutions and services, including transportation and distribution, warehousing, in-factory logistics, and value added services.

MANKIND.NS.d: Mankind Pharma Limited develops, manufactures and markets pharmaceutical medicines and consumer health products, mainly in India and also in international markets. Its pharmaceutical business addresses acute and chronic therapy areas including infectious diseases, cardiovascular and gastrointestinal conditions.

MAZDA.NS.d: Mazda Limited operates as an engineering company in India. It operates in two segments, Engineering Division and Food Division. The company offers vacuum systems, including steam jet boosters and ejectors; steam jet air ejector systems; combination vacuum systems of steam jet ejectors and liquid ring vacuum pumps; combination vacuum systems of steam jet ejectors and liquid jet ejectors; thermocompressors; liquid jet ejectors; air jet ejectors; vapor and gas jet ejectors/systems; steam jet liquid ejectors; liquid…

NAHARSPING.NS.d: Nahar Spinning Mills Ltd manufactures and sells yarns and knitted garments in India. The company offers raw white combed, raw white carded/open end, dyed, organic cotton, fair trade cotton, better cotton initiative, melange, gassed/mercerized, compact spun, blended, synthetic/man-made fiber, and cleaner yarns, as well as grindle, space dyed, slub, core spun, high twist, reverse twist, and elitwist yarns. It also provides woolen/cotton hosiery knit-wears and woolen textiles; and T-shirts.

NEULANDLAB.NS.d: Neuland Laboratories Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company's APIs are used in various therapeutic areas, including antiasthmatics, cardiovasculars, antifungal, anticonvulsants, antiemetic, central nervous system, fluoroquinolones, corticosteroids, antipsychotic, antibacterial and anti-parkinson, anti-ulcerants, and prostaglandins.

NIBE.NS.d: Nibe Limited manufactures integrated components for the defence sector, such as precision weapons, protective vehicles and surveillance communication gear. It has also expanded into electric vehicles.

OLAELEC.NS.d: Ola Electric Mobility Limited is a Bengaluru-based company founded in 2017 that develops, makes and sells electric vehicles in India. Its portfolio includes electric scooters and key components such as battery packs, motors and vehicle structures, and it also provides charging infrastructure solutions.

ORIENTTECH.NS.d: Orient Technologies Ltd. is a Mumbai-based IT services provider serving India and international markets. Its three divisions are IT infrastructure products and services, cloud with DevOps and data management, and IT-enabled services. Its infrastructure work covers design and consulting, turnkey network and data center integration with hardware and software, and cloud and storage solutions.

PAUSHAKLTD.NS.d: Paushak Limited manufactures and sells phosgene-based specialty chemicals. The company serves the pharmaceutical, agrochemical, and polymer industries. Paushak Limited is based in India.

PENINLAND.NS.d: Peninsula Land Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. The company develops residential complexes; commercial spaces and IT parks under the Peninsula brand; and shopping malls under the Crossroads brand. It also rents properties. The company was incorporated in 1871 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Peninsula Land Limited is a subsidiary of Ashok Piramal Group Real Estate Trust.

QUINT.NS.d: Quint Digital Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker QUINT and traded in INR. Its country is India.

RAMANEWS.NS.d: Shree Rama Newsprint Limited manufactures and sells newsprint, and writing and printing papers in India. The company also offers photocopier paper; and packaged drinking water. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rama Newsprint and Papers Limited and changed its name to Shree Rama Newsprint Limited in June 2013. Shree Rama Newsprint Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

SCPL.NS.d: Sheetal Cool Products Limited, established in Amreli in 1987, makes and distributes food products in India through Milk and Milk Products and Namkeen Products segments. Its ice creams, sold as Sheetal, Rick cream and J'adore, come as cups, bars, cones, kulfi and family tubs, and it also sells other dairy goods and savory snacks.

SHIVATEX.NS.d: Shiva Texyarn Limited manufactures and markets cotton yarn, and technical and other value added textile products in India and internationally. The company offers combed, carded, and compact yarns; slub and fancy yarns; quick dry products; quick fit products, including mattresses protectors; and baby products.

SHRIKRISH.NS.d: Shri Krishna Devcon Limited is an Indian construction company involved in infrastructure development projects. They undertake projects related to roads, bridges, and buildings. The company is based in India.

SHRINGARMS.NS.d: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHRINGARMS and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SIDDHIKA-ST.NS.d: Siddhika Coatings Limited is an Indian company involved in the manufacturing and supply of industrial coatings and paints. The company caters to various industries, providing specialized coating solutions. Siddhika Coatings is based in India.

SOLARINDS.NS.d: Solar Industries India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies industrial explosives and explosive initiating devices in India and internationally. It offers industrial explosives, such as packaged and bulk explosives; and initiating systems, including electronic, non-electric, electric, and plain detonators, as well as cord relays, cast boosters, detonating cords, and aluminium elemented det products.

STEELCITY.NS.d: Steel City Securities Limited provides retail stock broking services in southern parts of India. It provides a trading platform of capital market, futures and options, commodities, and currency derivatives; acts as a depository participant; offers margin trading facility for stocks or derivatives traded on National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE; and distributes mutual funds, credit cards, corporate fixed deposits, bonds, and IPOs.

TATACOMM.NS.d: Tata Communications Limited provides telecommunications services worldwide. The company operates through Voice Solutions, Data and Managed Services, and Real Estate segments.

TOLINS.NS.d: Tolins Tyres Limited, established in 1982 and based in Aluva, India, produces and distributes tires and tread rubber. Tires cover two- and three-wheelers, light commercial vehicles and farm uses, and it supplies precured tread rubber and retreading materials such as bonding gum and curing bags. It exports to about 40 countries.

TOTAL.NS.d: Total Transport Systems Limited provides logistic services worldwide. It engages in the consolidation and deconsolidation of cargo, freight forwarding, and warehousing and transportation for Fareast and The Gulf. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

VIDYAWIRES.NS.d: Vidya Wires Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VIDYAWIRES and traded in INR. Its country is India.

XTGLOBAL.NS.d: XTGlobal Infotech Ltd., established in Hyderabad in 1986 and called Frontier Informatics Limited until December 2019, provides software solutions worldwide. It develops software products, offers specialised training and provides IT services including application development and cloud and infrastructure services.

ZEEMEDIA.NS.d: Zee Media Corpor ation Limited engages in the broadcasting of satellite television channels in India. The company also sells television programs and contents; and provides advertisement and subscription services.

ZENSARTECH.NS.d: Zensar Technologies Limited, a digital solutions and technology services company, provides information technology (IT) services and solutions in the United states, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Application Management Services and Infrastructure Management Services segments. The company offers digital supply chain, enterprise analytics, customer experience transformation, agile IT modernization, and digital solutions.
